# skill:figure-style kernel.py (auto-injected on skill load)
META_GREY = "#888888"


def apply_figure_style(*, frame="open", font=None, sizes=(8, 7, 6), grid=False):
    """Set matplotlib rcParams for publication-grade output. Call once before plotting.

    This sets mechanics (role-mapped font-size ladder, outward ticks, frameless
    legends, 300-dpi save, Type-42 embedded fonts) — not a house aesthetic.
    Frame, font and the size ladder are parameters.

    frame : 'open' (bottom+left spines, default) | 'boxed' (all four) | 'none'
    font  : sans-serif family name; None = system default sans-serif
    sizes : (base, secondary, tick) — titles/axis-labels, legend/annotation, ticks
    grid  : whether to draw axes.grid (default False)
    """
    import matplotlib as mpl
    if frame not in ("open", "boxed", "none"):
        raise ValueError(f"frame must be 'open'|'boxed'|'none', got {frame!r}")

    try:
        import os, sys, glob, matplotlib.font_manager as fm
        fdir = os.path.join(os.environ.get("CONDA_PREFIX") or sys.prefix, "fonts")
        if os.path.isdir(fdir):
            known = {f.fname for f in fm.fontManager.ttflist}
            for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(fdir, "*.ttf")):
                if f not in known:
                    fm.fontManager.addfont(f)
    except Exception:
        pass
    base, secondary, tick = sizes
    boxed = (frame == "boxed")
    rc = {
        "font.family": "sans-serif",
        "font.size": base,
        "axes.labelsize": base,
        "axes.titlesize": base,
        "legend.fontsize": secondary,
        "xtick.labelsize": tick,
        "ytick.labelsize": tick,
        "axes.linewidth": 0.6,
        "xtick.direction": "out", "ytick.direction": "out",
        "xtick.major.size": 3, "ytick.major.size": 3,
        "xtick.major.width": 0.6, "ytick.major.width": 0.6,
        "axes.spines.top": boxed, "axes.spines.right": boxed,
        "axes.spines.left": frame != "none", "axes.spines.bottom": frame != "none",
        "axes.grid": bool(grid),
        "legend.frameon": False,
        "figure.dpi": 200,
        "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.bbox": "tight",
        "axes.titleweight": "normal",
        "axes.titlelocation": "left",
        "axes.labelweight": "normal",
        "lines.linewidth": 1.2,
        "patch.linewidth": 0.6,
        "pdf.fonttype": 42, "ps.fonttype": 42,
    }
    if font:
        rc["font.sans-serif"] = [font, "DejaVu Sans"]
    mpl.rcParams.update(rc)


def set_frame(ax, style="open"):
    """§3: set spine visibility on an existing axes. style ∈ {'open','boxed','none'}."""
    show = {"open": (False, False, True, True),
            "boxed": (True, True, True, True),
            "none": (False, False, False, False)}[style]
    for side, vis in zip(("top", "right", "bottom", "left"), show):
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(vis)
        if vis:
            ax.spines[side].set_linewidth(0.6)
    ax.tick_params(direction="out", length=0 if style == "none" else 3, width=0.6)


def panel_letter(ax, letter, dx=-0.18, dy=1.02, case="lower", fontsize=None):
    """§5.7: bold panel letter outside top-left of axes. case ∈ {'lower','upper'}."""
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    if fontsize is None:
        fontsize = plt.rcParams.get("font.size", 8) + 1
    s = letter.lower() if case == "lower" else letter.upper()
    ax.text(dx, dy, s, transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontweight="bold", fontsize=fontsize, va="bottom", ha="left")


def focal_palette(labels, focal, focal_color, other="muted", base_colors=None):
    """§4.2: map labels → colors with the focal series visually dominant.

    other='muted'   — desaturate base_colors (or a default cycle) toward gray
    other='grey'    — uniform light gray for all non-focal
    other='ordinal' — non-focal on a single light→dark gray ramp (input order)
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    focal_set = {focal} if isinstance(focal, str) else set(focal)
    n = len(labels)
    if not focal_set & set(labels):
        raise ValueError(f"focal {focal!r} not found in labels")
    if base_colors is None:
        base_colors = plt.rcParams["axes.prop_cycle"].by_key().get("color", ["#444444"])
    base_colors = [base_colors[i % len(base_colors)] for i in range(n)]
    if other == "grey":
        rest = ["#BCBCBC"] * n
    elif other == "ordinal":
        nf = max(1, n - len(focal_set))
        ramp = [mcolors.to_hex((v, v, v)) for v in
                ([0.55] if nf == 1 else [0.80 - 0.35 * i / (nf - 1) for i in range(nf)])]
        rest, k = [], 0
        for l in labels:
            rest.append(ramp[min(k, nf - 1)]); k += (l not in focal_set)
    else:
        def mute(c):
            r, g, b = mcolors.to_rgb(c)
            m = (r + g + b) / 3
            return mcolors.to_hex((0.3 * r + 0.7 * m, 0.3 * g + 0.7 * m, 0.3 * b + 0.7 * m))
        rest = [mute(c) for c in base_colors]
    return [focal_color if l in focal_set else rest[i] for i, l in enumerate(labels)]


def bar_with_points(ax, x, ymat, labels, colors, jitter=0.08, show_points=True,
                    errorbar=None, point_alpha=0.5, point_size=8):
    """§6.1: bar = mean; optionally overlay raw points or draw an interval.

    colors   : per-label color list (e.g. from focal_palette)
    errorbar : None | 'sd' | 'ci95' — drawn only when show_points is False.
               'ci95' is the t-distribution 95% CI of the mean
               (half-width t_{0.975,n-1} · s/√n); correct at small n where the
               z-approximation (1.96·s/√n) is markedly too narrow.
    """
    import numpy as np
    means = np.array([np.mean(y) for y in ymat], float)
    err = None
    if errorbar and not show_points:
        if errorbar == "sd":
            err = np.array([np.std(y, ddof=1) if np.asarray(y).size > 1 else 0 for y in ymat])
        elif errorbar == "ci95":
            from scipy.stats import t
            def _hw(y):
                n = np.asarray(y).size
                return t.ppf(0.975, n - 1) * np.std(y, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n) if n > 1 else 0
            err = np.array([_hw(y) for y in ymat])
    ax.bar(x, means, color=colors, width=0.7, edgecolor="none",
           yerr=err, error_kw={"elinewidth": 0.8, "capsize": 0})
    if show_points:
        for xi, ys in zip(x, ymat):
            ys = np.asarray(ys)
            if ys.ndim and ys.size > 1:
                jit = (np.random.rand(ys.size) - 0.5) * 2 * jitter
                ax.scatter(np.full(ys.size, xi) + jit, ys, s=point_size, color="black",
                           alpha=point_alpha, zorder=3, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
    return ax


def strip_with_median(ax, groups, values, colors=None, jitter=0.12):
    """§6.1: jittered points + bold horizontal median tick per group."""
    import numpy as np
    labs = list(groups)
    if colors is None:
        colors = ["#444444"] * len(labs)
    for i, (ys, c) in enumerate(zip(values, colors)):
        ys = np.asarray(ys)
        jit = (np.random.rand(ys.size) - 0.5) * 2 * jitter
        ax.scatter(np.full(ys.size, i) + jit, ys, s=10, color=c, alpha=0.6, linewidths=0, zorder=2)
        m = np.median(ys)
        ax.plot([i - 0.22, i + 0.22], [m, m], color="black", lw=1.6, zorder=3)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(labs))); ax.set_xticklabels(labs)
    return ax


def goodness_arrow(ax, text="higher = better", loc="upper left", axis="y", fontsize=None):
    """§3.6: small upright direction-of-goodness cue in the margin."""
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    if fontsize is None:
        fontsize = plt.rcParams["legend.fontsize"]
    pos = {"upper left": (0.02, 0.98), "upper right": (0.98, 0.98),
           "lower left": (0.02, 0.02), "lower right": (0.98, 0.02)}[loc]
    ha = "left" if "left" in loc else "right"
    va = "top" if "upper" in loc else "bottom"
    arrow = "↑ " if axis == "y" else "→ "
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1], arrow + text, transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontsize=fontsize, color=META_GREY, ha=ha, va=va)


def two_tier_label(name, meta):
    """§5: two-line label string (name / metadata). Meta line styled separately by caller."""
    return f"{name}\n{meta}"


def end_of_line_labels(ax, xs, ys, labels, colors=None, dx=0.01, fontsize=None):
    """§6.3 / §7.3: label each line series at its right end instead of a legend box."""
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    if fontsize is None:
        fontsize = plt.rcParams["font.size"]
    if colors is None:
        colors = [None] * len(labels)
    span = ax.get_xlim()[1] - ax.get_xlim()[0]
    for x, y, lab, c in zip(xs, ys, labels, colors):
        ax.text(x[-1] + dx * span, y[-1], lab, color=c, va="center", ha="left", fontsize=fontsize)


def panel_crops(fig, dpi=None, pad_px=6, bbox_inches=None, pad_inches=None):
    """§9.2: pixel-space crop boxes for each lettered panel in the SAVED PNG.

    Returns ``{letter: (x0, y0, x1, y1)}`` in image-space pixels (origin
    top-left, matching ``host.view_image(path, crop=...)`` and PIL's
    ``Image.crop``). Panels are detected as bold single-character ``Text``
    objects placed by :func:`panel_letter`; each panel's crop is its axes'
    tightbbox mapped into the saved file's pixel space, padded by ``pad_px``.
    For §3.4 composites (abutting subplots sharing an axis, letter on the
    leftmost only) the crop unions in letterless ``sharex``/``sharey`` siblings
    on the same grid row/col so the whole composite is covered. When no axes
    carries a panel letter (standalone plot, or a figure-composer sub-agent),
    falls back to one crop per axes keyed by index.

    ``bbox_inches`` mirrors ``Figure.savefig`` semantics: ``None`` means
    *consult rcParams* (so under :func:`apply_figure_style` it resolves to
    ``'tight'``); pass an explicit ``Bbox`` only if you saved with one. The
    boxes are clamped to the saved image extent regardless.

        >>> fig.savefig("fig.png")            # bbox_inches='tight' via rcParams
        >>> for letter, box in panel_crops(fig).items():
        ...     host.view_image("fig.png", crop=box)
    """
    import matplotlib as mpl
    import matplotlib.text
    if dpi is None:
        dpi = mpl.rcParams.get("savefig.dpi", fig.dpi)
        if dpi == "figure":
            dpi = fig.dpi
    dpi = float(dpi)
    if bbox_inches is None:
        bbox_inches = mpl.rcParams.get("savefig.bbox")
    fig.canvas.draw()
    r = fig.canvas.get_renderer()

    if bbox_inches == "tight":
        if pad_inches is None:
            pad_inches = mpl.rcParams.get("savefig.pad_inches", 0.1)
        tb = fig.get_tightbbox(r).padded(pad_inches)
        ox_in, oy_in = tb.x0, tb.y0
        W_in, H_in = tb.width, tb.height
    elif isinstance(bbox_inches, mpl.transforms.BboxBase):
        ox_in, oy_in = bbox_inches.x0, bbox_inches.y0
        W_in, H_in = bbox_inches.width, bbox_inches.height
    else:
        ox_in, oy_in = 0.0, 0.0
        W_in, H_in = fig.get_size_inches()
    W_px, H_px = int(round(W_in * dpi)), int(round(H_in * dpi))
    lettered = {}
    for ax in fig.axes:
        for t in ax.findobj(matplotlib.text.Text):
            s = (t.get_text() or "").strip()
            if len(s) == 1 and s.isalpha() and t.get_fontweight() in ("bold", 700):
                lettered[ax] = s
                break



    if not lettered:
        lettered = {ax: str(i) for i, ax in enumerate(fig.axes)}
    out = {}
    for ax, letter in lettered.items():
        bbs = [ax.get_tightbbox(r)]




        ss = ax.get_subplotspec()
        for sib in fig.axes:
            if sib is ax or sib in lettered:
                continue
            ssib = sib.get_subplotspec()
            same_row = ss is None or ssib is None or ss.rowspan == ssib.rowspan
            same_col = ss is None or ssib is None or ss.colspan == ssib.colspan
            if ((ax.get_shared_y_axes().joined(ax, sib) and same_row)
                    or (ax.get_shared_x_axes().joined(ax, sib) and same_col)):
                bbs.append(sib.get_tightbbox(r))
        bb = mpl.transforms.Bbox.union(bbs)

        bx0 = (bb.x0 / fig.dpi - ox_in) * dpi
        bx1 = (bb.x1 / fig.dpi - ox_in) * dpi
        by0 = H_px - (bb.y1 / fig.dpi - oy_in) * dpi
        by1 = H_px - (bb.y0 / fig.dpi - oy_in) * dpi
        out[letter] = (
            max(int(bx0) - pad_px, 0),
            max(int(by0) - pad_px, 0),
            min(int(bx1) + pad_px, W_px),
            min(int(by1) + pad_px, H_px),
        )
    return out

script = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
NORDCAN 5-year relative survival: Finland vs Sweden/Norway benchmark, 1990-2024.
Cancers: lung (160), pancreas (130), liver (110). Sexes: male (1), female (2).

Data source (live): NORDCAN v2 API, IARC/WHO
  https://canapi.iarc.who.int/api/nordcan/v2/961/survival/population/5/{sex}/{countries}/{cancer}/
  ?surv_period=5&age_surv=0&year_start=1973&year_end=2023
  - path '5'      = follow-up time 5 years
  - surv_period=5 = 5-calendar-year diagnosis periods
  - age_surv=0    = all ages combined (age-standardised summary; age_surv=1/2 return age-specific rows)

Outputs (written to CWD):
  raw_api/survival_cancer{C}_sex{S}.json   raw API payloads (offline re-run)
  raw_api/manifest.json                    URLs, status, record counts, sha256
  nordcan_survival_1990_2024.csv           tidy per-country estimates + benchmark + gap
  nordcan_gap_summary.csv                  latest gap, gap trend/decade, lag in years
  nordcan_lung.png / _pancreas.png / _liver.png
Re-run offline: set OFFLINE=True to read raw_api/*.json instead of fetching.
"""
import json, os, hashlib, time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OFFLINE   = False
BASE      = "https://canapi.iarc.who.int/api/nordcan/v2/961"
COUNTRIES = "246_752_578_208"                 # Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark
CANCERS   = {160: "Lung", 130: "Pancreas", 110: "Liver"}
SEXES     = {1: "Male", 2: "Female"}
PERIODS   = [f"{y}-{y+4}" for y in range(1990, 2021, 5)]   # 1990-1994 ... 2020-2024
FOCAL, BENCH = "Finland", ["Sweden", "Norway"]
Z = 1.959963985                               # normal quantile for the 95% CIs the API reports

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fetch / load
def get_payloads():
    os.makedirs("raw_api", exist_ok=True)
    payloads, manifest = {}, []
    for c in CANCERS:
        for s in SEXES:
            fn = f"raw_api/survival_cancer{c}_sex{s}.json"
            url = f"{BASE}/survival/population/5/{s}/{COUNTRIES}/{c}/"
            par = {"surv_period": 5, "age_surv": 0, "year_start": 1973, "year_end": 2023}
            if OFFLINE:
                text, status, full = open(fn).read(), "offline", url
            else:
                r = requests.get(url, params=par, timeout=60)
                r.raise_for_status()
                text, status, full = r.text, r.status_code, r.url
                with open(fn, "w") as f:
                    f.write(text)
                time.sleep(0.3)
            j = json.loads(text)
            payloads[(c, s)] = j
            manifest.append(dict(cancer=c, cancer_label=CANCERS[c], sex=s, sex_label=SEXES[s],
                                 url=full, status=status, n_records=len(j.get("dataset", [])),
                                 api_error=j.get("error"), file=fn,
                                 sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()))
    with open("raw_api/manifest.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2)
    return payloads, manifest

def tidy(payloads):
    rows = []
    for (c, s), j in payloads.items():
        for d in j["dataset"]:
            sv = d.get("survival") or {}
            rows.append(dict(cancer=c, cancer_label=CANCERS[c], sex=s, sex_label=SEXES[s],
                             country=d["country"], country_label=d["label"],
                             period=d["period"], year_mid=float(d["year"]),
                             survival=sv.get("value"), lowCI=sv.get("lowCI"), upCI=sv.get("upCI")))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    for col in ("survival", "lowCI", "upCI"):
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
    df["se"] = (df.upCI - df.lowCI) / (2 * Z)          # derived from API-reported 95% CI
    return df.sort_values(["cancer", "sex", "country_label", "year_mid"]).reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gap / trend / lag
def build_table(df):
    d = df[df.period.isin(PERIODS)]
    wide = d.pivot_table(index=["cancer_label", "sex_label", "period", "year_mid"],
                         columns="country_label", values=["survival", "se"])
    out = []
    for (can, sex, per, ymid), r in wide.iterrows():
        rec = dict(cancer=can, sex=sex, period=per, year_mid=ymid)
        for ctry in ["Finland", "Sweden", "Norway", "Denmark"]:
            rec[f"surv_{ctry}"] = r.get(("survival", ctry), np.nan)
            rec[f"se_{ctry}"]   = r.get(("se", ctry), np.nan)
        se_no  = [rec["surv_Sweden"], rec["surv_Norway"]]
        se_var = [rec["se_Sweden"], rec["se_Norway"]]
        if not any(pd.isna(v) for v in se_no):
            rec["benchmark_SE_NO_mean"] = float(np.mean(se_no))
            bse = float(np.sqrt(np.sum(np.array(se_var) ** 2)) / 2)
            rec["benchmark_se"] = bse
            if not pd.isna(rec["surv_Finland"]):
                rec["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"] = rec["surv_Finland"] - rec["benchmark_SE_NO_mean"]
                gse = float(np.sqrt(rec["se_Finland"] ** 2 + bse ** 2))
                rec["gap_se"]    = gse
                rec["gap_lowCI"] = rec["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"] - Z * gse
                rec["gap_upCI"]  = rec["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"] + Z * gse
        out.append(rec)
    t = pd.DataFrame(out).sort_values(["cancer", "sex", "year_mid"])
    for c in ["benchmark_SE_NO_mean", "benchmark_se", "gap_FI_minus_benchmark",
              "gap_se", "gap_lowCI", "gap_upCI"]:
        t[c] = t.get(c, np.nan)
    return t.reset_index(drop=True)

def slope_per_decade(x, y):
    """OLS slope x10 with 95% CI; needs >=3 points."""
    x, y = np.asarray(x, float), np.asarray(y, float)
    m = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    if m.sum() < 3:
        return (np.nan,) * 4 + (int(m.sum()),)
    lr = stats.linregress(x[m], y[m])
    tcrit = stats.t.ppf(0.975, m.sum() - 2)
    return (lr.slope * 10, (lr.slope - tcrit * lr.stderr) * 10,
            (lr.slope + tcrit * lr.stderr) * 10, lr.pvalue, int(m.sum()))

def lag_years(years, bench, fi_latest, latest_year):
    """Calendar years by which the SE/NO benchmark curve reached Finland's latest value."""
    y = np.asarray(years, float); b = np.asarray(bench, float)
    m = ~np.isnan(b); y, b = y[m], b[m]
    if len(y) < 2 or np.isnan(fi_latest):
        return np.nan, "insufficient benchmark series"
    if b[-1] <= fi_latest:
        return 0.0, "Finland at or above benchmark in latest period"
    for i in range(1, len(b)):                      # first upward crossing of fi_latest
        if b[i] >= fi_latest > b[i - 1]:
            t = y[i - 1] + (fi_latest - b[i - 1]) * (y[i] - y[i - 1]) / (b[i] - b[i - 1])
            return float(latest_year - t), "interpolated crossing"
    if b[0] >= fi_latest:
        return float(latest_year - y[0]), f">= {latest_year - y[0]:.0f} y (benchmark already above in {int(y[0])})"
    return np.nan, "no crossing within available periods"

def summarise(t):
    rows = []
    for (can, sex), g in t.groupby(["cancer", "sex"], sort=False):
        g = g.sort_values("year_mid")
        gv = g.dropna(subset=["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"])
        last = g[g.period == PERIODS[-1]]
        last = last.iloc[0] if len(last) else None
        sl = slope_per_decade(gv.year_mid, gv.gap_FI_minus_benchmark)
        fi_sl = slope_per_decade(g.year_mid, g.surv_Finland)
        bn_sl = slope_per_decade(g.year_mid, g.benchmark_SE_NO_mean)
        lag, lagnote = (lag_years(g.year_mid, g.benchmark_SE_NO_mean,
                                 last["surv_Finland"], last["year_mid"])
                        if last is not None else (np.nan, "latest period absent"))
        rows.append(dict(
            cancer=can, sex=sex,
            latest_period=PERIODS[-1],
            surv_Finland_latest=None if last is None else last["surv_Finland"],
            benchmark_latest=None if last is None else last["benchmark_SE_NO_mean"],
            gap_latest=None if last is None else last["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"],
            gap_latest_lowCI=None if last is None else last["gap_lowCI"],
            gap_latest_upCI=None if last is None else last["gap_upCI"],
            gap_change_per_decade=sl[0], gap_change_lowCI=sl[1],
            gap_change_upCI=sl[2], gap_change_p=sl[3], n_periods_gap=sl[4],
            gap_periods_used=f"{gv.period.iloc[0]}..{gv.period.iloc[-1]}" if len(gv) else "none",
            finland_trend_per_decade=fi_sl[0], benchmark_trend_per_decade=bn_sl[0],
            lag_years=lag, lag_note=lagnote))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- figure
COL = {"Finland": "#C2272D", "Sweden": "#2B6CB0", "Norway": "#1B9E77",
       "Denmark": "#9AA0A6", "SE/NO mean": "#111111"}

def make_figure(t, cancer, fname):
    from kernel import apply_figure_style, panel_letter, set_frame  # noqa
    sub = t[t.cancer == cancer]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(10.5, 3.5))
    for ax, sex in zip(axes[:2], ["Male", "Female"]):
        g = sub[sub.sex == sex].sort_values("year_mid")
        ax.fill_between(g.year_mid, g.surv_Finland - Z * g.se_Finland,
                        g.surv_Finland + Z * g.se_Finland, color=COL["Finland"], alpha=.15, lw=0)
        for ctry, lw, ls, alpha in [("Denmark", 1.2, (0, (1, 1.6)), .9), ("Sweden", 1.5, "-", .95),
                                    ("Norway", 1.5, "-", .95), ("Finland", 2.6, "-", 1.0)]:
            ax.plot(g.year_mid, g[f"surv_{ctry}"], ls=ls, lw=lw, color=COL[ctry],
                    alpha=alpha, marker="o" if ctry == "Finland" else None, ms=3.4, zorder=3)
        ax.plot(g.year_mid, g.benchmark_SE_NO_mean, ls=(0, (5, 2)), lw=1.6,
                color=COL["SE/NO mean"], zorder=4)
        ax.set_title(f"{sex}s", loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("Period of diagnosis (mid-year)")
        ax.margins(.05)
    axes[0].set_ylabel("5-year relative survival (%)")
    ymax = max(np.nanmax(sub[[f"surv_{c}" for c in COL if c != 'SE/NO mean']].values) * 1.12, 5)
    for ax in axes[:2]:
        ax.set_ylim(0, ymax)
    axes[1].set_yticklabels([])

    ax = axes[2]
    ax.axhline(0, color=COL["SE/NO mean"], lw=1.1, ls=(0, (5, 2)), zorder=1)
    for sex, mk, ls in [("Male", "o", "-"), ("Female", "s", (0, (4, 1.5)))]:
        g = sub[sub.sex == sex].sort_values("year_mid").dropna(subset=["gap_FI_minus_benchmark"])
        ax.fill_between(g.year_mid, g.gap_lowCI, g.gap_upCI, color=COL["Finland"], alpha=.12, lw=0)
        ax.plot(g.year_mid, g.gap_FI_minus_benchmark, ls=ls, lw=2.0, marker=mk, ms=4,
                color=COL["Finland"], label=sex, zorder=3)
    ax.set_title("Finland minus Sweden/Norway mean", loc="left")
    ax.set_xlabel("Period of diagnosis (mid-year)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Gap (percentage points)")
    ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="best")
    ax.margins(.08)

    # series identity: direct labels in panel 1
    g = sub[sub.sex == "Male"].sort_values("year_mid")
    hand = [mpl.lines.Line2D([], [], color=COL[k], lw=lw, ls=ls, label=k) for k, lw, ls in
            [("Finland", 2.6, "-"), ("Sweden", 1.5, "-"), ("Norway", 1.5, "-"),
             ("SE/NO mean", 1.6, (0, (5, 2))), ("Denmark", 1.2, (0, (1, 1.6)))]]
    axes[0].legend(handles=hand, frameon=False, loc="upper left", ncol=1,
                   handlelength=1.8, borderaxespad=0.2)
    for a, L in zip(axes, "abc"):
        panel_letter(a, L)
        set_frame(a, "lb")
    fig.suptitle(f"{cancer} cancer: 5-year relative survival, Nordic countries, 1990-2024",
                 x=0.005, ha="left")
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.94))
    fig.savefig(fname, dpi=300)
    return fig

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main
if __name__ == "__main__":
    payloads, manifest = get_payloads()
    df = tidy(payloads)
    df.to_csv("nordcan_survival_long_all_periods.csv", index=False)
    tab = build_table(df)
    tab.to_csv("nordcan_survival_1990_2024.csv", index=False)
    summ = summarise(tab)
    summ.to_csv("nordcan_gap_summary.csv", index=False)
    for c, f in [("Lung", "nordcan_lung.png"), ("Pancreas", "nordcan_pancreas.png"),
                 ("Liver", "nordcan_liver.png")]:
        make_figure(tab, c, f)
    print(summ.to_string(index=False))
'''
